title: Preallocate DDL table data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DDL table operations build data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added table_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced DROP TABLE data scan prefix construction.
Replaced TRUNCATE TABLE data scan prefix construction.
Replaced ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN row-rewrite scan prefix construction.
Replaced ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY row-rewrite scan prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: DDL table data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving table drop, truncate, row-cache invalidation, row rewrite, and SQL DDL behavior.
